records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 內嵌於 Microsoft 365 商業與消費者版的雲端服務，讓 AI 功能成為產品組合的一部份，藉此提升使用者黏著度、每位使用者平均收入（ARPU）以及整體雲端營收【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。

- 在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品線中，Copilot 被列為「Microsoft 365 Copilot」與其他服務（如 Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams 等）共同組成的 AI‑驅動平台【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。  
- 2026 財年，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端營收因 Copilot 及 Microsoft 365 E5 帶動的每位使用者收入成長而上升 17%【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】；同時商業版座位數因針對中小企業與前線工作者的方案而成長 6%【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的擴增，成本項目（Cost of revenue）增加了 12%（約 26 億美元），主要是投入 AI 基礎設施【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- 毛利率因 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的成長（包括 Copilot）而提升 17%（約 166 億美元），顯示 Copilot 的加入提升了整體利潤貢獻【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- 依 AvePoint 2026 年 6 月的新聞，Microsoft 365 的使用者座位約在 4‑5 億間，Copilot 的滲透率約為 5%，顯示仍有大量擴展空間【MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2】。  

綜合以上，Microsoft 以「Microsoft 365 Copilot」作為 AI 功能的核心，將其嵌入所有主要生產力與協作應用，並透過提升每位使用者收入、擴大座位數以及加大 AI 基礎設施投資，將 Copilot 作為推動 Microsoft 365 從傳統授權向以訂閱為主的 AI‑增值服務轉型的關鍵策略。

[MSFT] Microsoft Relationship Seen as Complementary
Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 作為入口，將使用者與裝置直接連結至 Azure 雲端與 Copilot 相關服務，從而提升這些服務的使用參與度【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #49】。

- Windows 內建與 Microsoft 365 及 Windows Commercial 雲端服務的整合，使企業在 Windows 裝置上使用 Microsoft 365 Commercial（含 Teams、Power BI、Exchange 等）時，同時產生 Azure 基礎設施與平台服務的需求，進一步推動 Azure 的基礎設施即服務 (IaaS) 與平台即服務 (PaaS) 消費【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。  
- 微軟在 Surface 與其他 PC 產品線中推出「Copilot+ PC」等具備 AI 助手功能的裝置，這些裝置在 Windows 作業系統上預裝 Copilot，讓使用者在日常工作與創作時即時呼叫 AI 功能，促使使用者更頻繁連線至雲端 AI 服務與資料存取【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #54】。  
- Windows 亦被用來推動 Microsoft Edge、Bing 搜尋與 Copilot 的整合，透過瀏覽器與搜尋平台的使用，引導使用者點擊或啟用 Copilot 相關功能，進一步提升雲端廣告與 AI 服務的觸及率【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #49】。  
- 微軟明確表示「Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business」以擴大 PC 市場佔有率，同時驅動與雲端服務（包括 Azure、Microsoft 365、Copilot）之間的交叉銷售與使用黏著度【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #49】。  

綜合以上，Windows 不僅是作業系統，更是連結 Azure 雲端基礎設施、Microsoft 365 生產力套件與 AI Copilot 的關鍵平台，透過預裝 AI 功能的裝置、服務整合與跨產品行銷，持續提升雲端與 Copilot 服務的使用率與參與度。

The Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility. Our cloud business benefits from three economies of scale: datacenters that deploy computational resources at significantly lower cost per unit than smaller ones; datacenters that coordinate and aggregate diverse customer, geographic, and application demand patterns, improving the utilization of computing, storage, and network resources; and multi-tenancy locations that lower application maintenance labor costs. We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets. To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads, including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing experiences that empower people to play, create, and interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟是透過在 Microsoft 365 商業版雲端服務中嵌入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot**，把 AI 功能直接整合到 Office 相關的生產力與協作工具裡【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。

- Microsoft 365 Copilot 被定位為 AI‑powered 的商務與生產力平台，將 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等核心產品與 AI 功能結合，提供 AI‑enabled 工具、特色與 agentic 場景，涵蓋通訊、協作、分析、安全與合規等領域【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。  
- 在 2025 年的 10‑Q 報告中，Microsoft 365 Copilot 仍屬於 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務的一部份，說明 AI 功能是透過雲端交付，與其他雲端服務共同支援使用者【MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #46】。  
- 2026 年的 10‑Q 亦同樣將 Microsoft 365 Copilot 列入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務，強調 AI 功能與雲端服務的結合是 Microsoft 產品策略的一環【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #44】。  

因此，微軟的做法是把 AI 以 Copilot 形式嵌入 Microsoft 365 的雲端平台，透過此平台向 Office 系列（如 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Outlook、Teams 等）提供 AI 驅動的分析、內容生成與安全合規建議等功能。這些 AI 功能隨著 Microsoft 365 Commercial 的成長與使用者基礎的擴大而持續擴充。

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜在 2026 年第一季直接投入約 **150 億美元** 購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署了額外 **350 億美元** 的購買承諾書，合計未來可能投入約 **500 億美元** 用於人工智慧相關投資，與 OpenAI 建立了資本合作關係。  

- 2026 年第一季，亞馬遜的現金支出（扣除已取得的現金）與收購及其他投資活動相關，總計 **154 億美元**【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 同期，亞馬遜投資 **150 億美元** 購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署了額外 **350 億美元** 的股權承諾書，條件符合時將進一步購買該股份，資金將以手頭現金支付【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 亞馬遜亦表示將持續對其人工智慧計畫進行額外投資，預期相關因素將持續影響 2026 年第三季的營運結果【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79】。  

因此，亞馬遜近期在 AI 領域的主要資金投入是對 **OpenAI** 的大額股權投資與未來承諾，顯示其正加速在生成式 AI 與相關技術上的布局。
